# Time Cluster

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A cluster whose subject is a single time period, at any horizon from a day to a year.

## Scope note

- Covers the five period clusters: DayCluster, WeekCluster, MonthCluster, QuarterCluster and YearCluster.
- Does not include the other kinds of cluster: EffortCluster and TopicCluster.
